title: Agencia Alfa Core Web Experience
description: Initial architecture and high-conversion web experience for Agencia Alfa (saas-b2b).
acceptance_criteria: Zero UI layout thrashing or horizontal overflow across 1440px, 768px, and 390px viewports.
100% WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility compliance (semantic landmarks <main>, <nav>, ARIA labels, APCA contrast).
Zero inline executable <script> blocks or inline onclick handlers (strict CSP compliance).
